chunks: We have sent you with the truth, to give glad tidings and to warn. Never has there been a community to which an admonisher was not sent.

key_terms.خَلَا: was not empty / did not lack

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about whether every nation received a prophet?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the completeness of divine guidance, affirming that every nation received a warner suited to its capacity, culminating in the finality of Prophet Muhammad's mission. It highlights the theological principle of 'adl' (divine justice), ensuring that no community is left without clear evidence before being held accountable on the Day of Judgment.
